flashcards_visibility_chk.name: flashcards_visibility_chk
flashcards_visibility_chk.value: ("flashcards"."visibility" = 'private' and "flashcards"."owner_id" is not null) or ("flashcards"."visibility" = 'editorial' and "flashcards"."owner_id" is null)

student_terms_dates_ck.name: student_terms_dates_ck
student_terms_dates_ck.value: "student_terms"."starts_on" is null or "student_terms"."ends_on" is null or "student_terms"."starts_on" <= "student_terms"."ends_on"

planning_limits_ck.name: planning_limits_ck
planning_limits_ck.value:
("planning_preferences"."daily_limit_minutes" is null or "planning_preferences"."daily_limit_minutes" between 0 and 1440)
        and ("planning_preferences"."weekly_limit_minutes" is null or "planning_preferences"."weekly_limit_minutes" between 0 and 6000)

planning_view_ck.name: planning_view_ck
planning_view_ck.value: "planning_preferences"."view_start_minute" between 0 and 1380 and "planning_preferences"."view_end_minute" between 60 and 1440 and "planning_preferences"."view_end_minute" > "planning_preferences"."view_start_minute"

notification_quiet_ck.name: notification_quiet_ck
notification_quiet_ck.value: ("notification_preferences"."quiet_from" is null) = ("notification_preferences"."quiet_until" is null) and ("notification_preferences"."quiet_from" is null or ("notification_preferences"."quiet_from" between 0 and 1439 and "notification_preferences"."quiet_until" between 0 and 1439))

content_marks_target_ck.name: content_marks_target_ck
content_marks_target_ck.value:
("content_marks"."target_type" = 'slide' AND "content_marks"."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_marks"."page" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("content_marks"."target_type" = 'regiao' AND "content_marks"."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_marks"."page" IS NOT NULL AND "content_marks"."region" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("content_marks"."target_type" = 'anotacao' AND "content_marks"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("content_marks"."target_type" = 'tema' AND "content_marks"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL)

creation_questions_kind_ck.name: creation_questions_kind_ck
creation_questions_kind_ck.value:
("creation_questions"."kind" = 'objetiva' and "creation_questions"."correct_index" is not null and cardinality("creation_questions"."options") >= 2)
        or ("creation_questions"."kind" = 'discursiva' and "creation_questions"."expected" is not null)
